method: Local Input/Context/Output hooks with supplied reports; no live model or website
positiveTraces: Explicit acceptance -> hear closing time (optional) -> clerk grants permission -> player enters reading room -> current scene recorded -> archivist offers favor -> player refuses (no acceptance) -> later explicitly accepts -> later shelves volume -> reload

Explicit acceptance -> archivist agrees to escort -> player waits (no movement/progress) -> player enters reading room -> current scene recorded -> archivist offers favor -> player refuses -> later explicitly accepts -> later shelves volume -> reload
Accepted favor -> player command abandons -> actual reported departure -> resume blocked -> actual reported return -> explicit resume without a new offer -> later shelving action completes
Actual favor offer -> explicit decline -> explicit reconsideration -> fresh actual offer -> separate player agreement -> later shelving work -> reload

Decline the unaccepted archive-entry goal -> lobby task eligible -> actual independent clerk offer -> separate player agreement -> later alphabetizing -> reload; source remains declined with zero work and archivist favor locked
Accept entry -> actual permission -> player enters reading room -> entry completes; lobby recovery remains locked
negativeCases: Optional completion alone cannot complete a stage
Neither permission nor an escort's agreement moves the player
Unchosen alternatives remain at their observed counts
Unfinished optional work cannot be backfilled after advancement
Partial totals on different alternatives cannot be summed
A locked or eligible follow-up is not yet offered or accepted
Refusal leaves the offered favor unaccepted
Narrator prose cannot prove a player-action objective
Source edits, Retry and rollback cannot retain discarded progress
Final abandonment does not finish the visit, grant rewards or unlock the follow-up
An abandoned quest cannot receive AI progress, failure or AI-authored resumption
Suggestions discarded at abandonment cannot be revived after resumption
Interface refusal establishes no spoken dialogue, NPC knowledge, room permission, player movement or source completion
An eligible recovery task is not offered or accepted; narrative wording without a valid report cannot create status outcomes
categoryCoverage: Category metadata is display-only; hidden/eligible categories are absent from player views, and creator-only exports may show the full roster.
